strengths: Correctly identified B-cell lineage from MS4A1, CD79A/B, CD22, BANK1, TNFRSF13C, FCER2, IGHM, TCL1A
Excluded T/NK/myeloid and plasma-cell alternatives using lineage markers
weaknesses: Top label was not mapped to a single CLID
Top1 remained at broad B-cell/B-lymphocyte level despite evidence supporting naive/mature B-cell state

strengths: B-cell identity strongly supported by DEGs and enrichment
weaknesses: Stopped at parent B-cell level; naive B cell (CL:0000788) was supported by TCL1A/FCER2/IGHM/TNFRSF13C but not selected as top1

strengths: Selected the most specific supported B-cell subtype (naive/mature B cell)
Used TCL1A, FCER2, TNFRSF13C, IGHM as positive support for naive/unswitched B-cell state
weaknesses: Candidate list contained unsupported alternatives (naive T cell, neuron) not supported by the DEG panel

supporting: In-scope DEGs are dominated by B-cell lineage markers: MS4A1, CD79A, CD79B, CD22, BANK1, TNFRSF13C, FCER2, IGHM, VPREB3
B-cell transcription factors SPIB, BCL11A, POU2F2, IRF8 and MHC class II genes (HLA-DRA, HLA-DRB1, HLA-DQB1, HLA-DMB, CD74) are present
Naive/mature B-cell state is positively supported by FCER2, TCL1A, TNFRSF13C, and IGHM
conflicting: No T-cell/NK-cell markers (CD3D, CD3E, CD8A, FCGR3A) appear in the DEG panel
CD83 and NFKBID hint at minor activation but are not lineage-restricted and do not override B-cell identity
enrichment_or_literature: Enrichment for B cell receptor signaling and MHC class II antigen presentation
PMID 35335635 as literature support for B-cell marker interpretation
